beta_hotfix_5_0_1.why: 5.0.0-beta.1 refused images a 64 GB PC with one RTX 5090 renders (Bolt and Redux 2x of 3500 x 2188, Redux 4x of 1280 x 1600): its estimate was above the measured peaks, its default limit was RAM less max(4 GB, 10 %), and it never tried a lighter setting for memory

changes.peak_model: 1.03 x (22.69 + 0.1463 x render MP + 0.2687 x output MP + 0.3078 x padded input MP) GB, the smallest upper envelope of the measured peaks plus a 3 % margin; never above the 5.0.0 estimate
changes.step_down: each pass takes the fullest supersample (2, 1.5, 1) that fits the memory limit before the image is refused; the plan and the caption say so (ram_limited)
changes.default_ram_cap_gb: RAM less max(2.5 GB, 4 %); 5.0.0's own default counts as a default on update, a value set by hand is kept
changes.start_check: counts the room a system-managed or custom page file has to grow; stops an idle engine on another card when its memory is needed
changes.bolt: says memory, not size, when a computer with more memory could run the image in Bolt
changes.stored_plans: plans stored by 5.0.0-beta.1 still match, so a stopped image queued again keeps its passes
changes.ci: the tests pin the computer's memory figure (ENHANCER_TEST_RAM_GB); the scans run before the tests
